verdict_reason: The new picker detail and pagination locators work, but their names differ from the repo's existing pagination names and the paging helper asserts inside the page object.

todos.issue: The new pagination locators name a concept the repo already names differently: party-picker-page.ts:74 'nextPageLink' and :70 'paginationPageLink', where list-page.ts:71 and both dashboard pages (ins/dashboard-page.ts:40, animals/dashboard-page.ts:131) say 'linkNextPage' and list-page.ts:115 says 'pageLink'. One concept, two names across sibling page objects.
todos.fix: Must: the Next page link and the numbered page link have one name each across every page object. One way: rename nextPageLink to linkNextPage and paginationPageLink to pageLink, and update addresses-picker.spec.ts.

todos.issue: followNextUntilListed (party-picker-page.ts:81) calls expect(...).toHaveAttribute('aria-current', 'page') inside a page object to wait for the next page. The Playwright guide keeps assertions in specs ('Assertions in page objects or flows: Hides intent'), and a failure here reports as a spec assertion that the spec never wrote.
todos.fix: Must: the page object waits for the next page without an assertion. One way: await this.paginationPageLink(pageNumber).and(this.page.locator('[aria-current="page"]')).waitFor(), and drop the expect import.
